configs.description: The lacing bar as Belden ships 9512-1903.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: the data sheet and the product page say the part is a rack-mount lacing bar and give no tie point, slot or cut-out along it, so none is drawn and no cable is told where to be tied.
gaps.wanted: a Belden drawing, or a square-on photograph, that marks where a cable is tied

gaps.note: the sheet gives 0.5 in for the height and for the depth. The photograph shows a thin flat strip, drawn 1.5 thick from the line's stand-in gauge. Which edge of the 12.7 depth it sits on is unknown.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing, or an end-on photograph, of the bar

gaps.note: the bar is 12.7 high and takes one 44.45 rack unit; no document says where in the unit it sits.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of the bar fitted to a rail

gaps.note: the photograph shows two loose screws beside the bar. They are not on any face and the format has no shape for a loose part beside a device. No document gives their size, thread or head.

gaps.wanted: no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, the colour and the finish are the data sheet's table. The overview sentence says the managers' 19 in mount "includes mounting hardware" and the photograph shows two screws; their size and thread are not stated and no part is modelled for them.

chassis.note: datasheet - 1U, 0.5 in (12.7 mm) high, 19 in (482.6 mm) wide and 0.5 in (12.7 mm) deep, the data sheet's Overall Height and Overall Width rows and its Variants table (Height 0.5 in, Width 19 in, Depth 0.5 in). The height is far under the 44.45 of the rack unit it takes, as the other Belden parts' heights are. The width is the 482.6 of 19 in, the bar's own length. The data sheet does not say which of the 0.5 in figures is the bar's face and which its projection from the rail face; see the `cross-section` gap.

color.note: estimated - "Black Powdercoat Finish" and "Color: Black". The photograph shows a dark steel bar that reads dark grey where it catches light, so the shade is this library's render of black, the same as the line's other 1U managers.

front.note: estimated - the bar's face as a 482.6 by 12.7 strip, the overall width and height, with one slotted hole at each end. Each hole is 10 by 4, its centre 13 from the end and 6.35 from the edge, read off the photograph: the centre sits 12 px from the end at 1.1 mm per px along the bar. The size is good to about 3.

guides.note: datasheet - none. A cable is tied to a lacing bar, and no document says where. The format has no tie point on a bar, and none is placed (`tie-points` gap).

left.note: estimated - the end of the strip, 12.7 across and 1.5 thick, on the rail side of the 12.7 depth. The right is the same.

method.note: FIGURES FROM A DATA SHEET TABLE AND ONE PHOTOGRAPH. The 9512-1903 technical data sheet (revision 0.41, 05-31-2024, page 1) states the rack units, the overall height and width, the depth (in its Variants table only), the weight, the material, the finish and the colour, and carries one 430 px photograph of the bar with its two screws lying beside it. The maker's product page held here is text with no dimension in it. NO BELDEN DOCUMENT HOLDS A DIMENSIONED DRAWING. The two end holes and the thin flat section are read off the photograph and are `estimated`: the scale is the printed 12.7 mm face over its 9.8 px width at the middle of the bar, 1.3 mm per px, and the length is the printed 482.6 over 438 px. Nothing was copied from the photograph; the data sheet's footer ("provided on an AS IS basis") grants no licence to reuse its artwork.

mount.note: estimated - the data sheet says only "Mount Type: 19 in". The photograph shows one slotted hole near each end of a flat bar and two screws beside it, so it bolts to the rail face at a rack unit and stands out from it: a `rack-face` part, as the line's other managers are. At what height inside the unit it sits is not stated.

rear.note: estimated - the back of the same strip, with the same two holes through it. No Belden document shows the bar from behind.

shell.note: estimated - `sheet`, as the line's other managers: the data sheet says "Steel" and the photograph shows a flat strip. The strip is drawn 12.7 across and 1.5 thick, its edge on the rail side. The sheet's 0.5 in depth is kept as the overall size.

thickness.note: estimated - 1.5, the stand-in the line's other managers use; no Belden document states a gauge for this bar.

top.note: estimated - the strip's edge, 482.6 long and 1.5 thick, on the rail side of the 12.7 depth. The bottom is the same.

weight.note: datasheet - 0.5 lb in the data sheet's Weight row and its Variants table, 0.227 kg. The data sheet does not say whether it is a net or a shipping weight, nor whether the two screws are in it.
